newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa eases slightly, 1,000 support holds.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa eases slightly, 1,000 support holds.

text.p: Cocoa futures stepped back further after Thursday's disappointing performance to end Friday midsession lower.
Both September and December, the two actively-traded months, skidded to near support levels of 1,000 and 1,035 stg respectively before moving away again.
"It found good buying around 1,000 and 1,035," said one trader. "The market will hold at these levels assuming New York does not collapse."
September finished nine stg down at 1,006 stg a tonne after a high of 1,010 and a low of 1,002 while December shed eight at 1,042 after ranging between 1,036 and 1,043.
After re-conquering the 1,000 level recently, the market was finding little follow-through buying to propel it much higher. Prices are now capped at 1,028, the double top seen this week.
But traders and technical analysts said cocoa was still proned to further test on the upside based on the encouraging technical picture.
"But fundamentally, there's not much to get excited about," one trader said.
Traders were keeping an eye on the U.S. CFTC Commitment of Traders report due after the close of New York trading on Friday to gauge the extent of spec long positions.
Overall volume was a paltry 1,079 lots.
